budget_items.topic: Turkey Hill Elementary School asbestos abatement
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The asbestos abatement is planned in three phases over FY18, FY19 and FY20, with the first two phases covering the first floor.
budget_items.quote: would be for this project to be done in three phases - fy18 ($145,000), fy19($127,000) and fy20 ($162,000).

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Three FY18 technology requests were listed: teachers' laptops, a server, and 30 replacement iPads.
budget_items.quote: replace teachers laptops $18,000 - 4 years old and out of warranty.

budget_items.topic: Air cooling system at Primary School
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Air cooling system work is requested for FY20 and FY21; the FY21 condenser installation must be done in one shot and cannot be spread over years.
budget_items.quote: air cooling system at primary school - fy20 ($10,000) and fy21 ($300,000).

budget_items.topic: Video surveillance at Primary School and Turkey Hill Elementary School
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Video surveillance installations at both schools are requested, to be done by one contractor at the same time for cost benefit.
budget_items.quote: video surveillance at primary school ($52,370) and turkey hill elementary school fy21 ($53,000)

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The FY24 roof replacement is timed to the Nexamp agreement, under which Nexamp absorbs the cost of removing and reinstalling the panels; the monetary projection is described as a worst case scenario and may be MSBA-eligible.
budget_items.quote: may be eligible for msba assistance and the monetary projection is a worst case scenario

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Removing a surplus portable classroom from the TCP building is estimated to cost about the figure printed.
budget_items.quote: the cost to remove the classroom will be about $25,000.
